name: quickjs_memory_limit
description: Maximum heap size of each QuickJS runtime (one per thread and query), e.g. '256MB'. 'none' disables the limit.

name: quickjs_timeout_ms
description: Maximum wall-clock time in milliseconds of a single QuickJS evaluation (one row of quickjs()/quickjs_eval(), or the whole quickjs table function). 0 disables the timeout.
